question: Should `CONTRIBUTING.md` stop carrying the in-repo maintainer roster and use the OpenClaw people page as the public roster/responsibility source?
rationale: This is a public governance/source-of-truth choice, and the protected `maintainer` label plus prior roster-source review mean automation should not decide the permanent docs contract.

options.title: Approve People Page As Canonical
options.body: Land this PR shape after confirming the people page is the public source for current maintainer identity and responsibility context.

options.title: Keep Minimal In-Repo Role Cues
options.body: Ask for a small revision that keeps a compact project-lead or area-responsibility cue in `CONTRIBUTING.md` while still linking the people page.

options.title: Pause The Roster Change
options.body: Keep the current in-repo roster until maintainers settle the broader roster and CODEOWNERS governance model.

recommendation.title: Approve People Page As Canonical
recommendation.body: Land this PR shape after confirming the people page is the public source for current maintainer identity and responsibility context.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS routes ownership-rule changes to this handle, and this handle closed the earlier roster-source PR with the relevant governance rationale.
